create.name: Demo Rinpoche
create.bio:
Demo Rinpoche is a Tibetan Buddhist lama who serves as spiritual director of Jewel Heart, the community founded by Gelek Rimpoche, and teaches from its centre in Ann Arbor, Michigan. Recognised by the Dalai Lama in 1986 as the eleventh in a line of reincarnate teachers, several of whose earlier holders acted as regents of Tibet, he entered Drepung Loseling monastery as a six-year-old. He spent a quarter of a century there, earning the Geshe Lharampa degree, the highest rank in the Gelug scholastic system, in 2012, and then completed tantric training at Gyume. Afterwards he moved to New York and took a master's in inter-religious engagement at Union Theological Seminary in 2018.

His teaching keeps to the lineage of Je Tsongkhapa while speaking plainly to people new to Buddhism. Most Sundays he gives a free public talk, in person in Ann Arbor and on Zoom, starting from everyday matters as varied as friendship and football; for one long stretch he retold the Jataka stories of the Buddha's earlier lives. He also leads seasonal seminars and retreats on texts such as Shantideva's Guide to the Bodhisattva's Way of Life, Nagarjuna's Precious Garland and Tsongkhapa's Praise of Dependent Origination, many of which can be streamed afterwards. Away from teaching he enjoys photography, poetry and sport.

courses.title: Summer Retreat 2025 - A Commentary on Tsongkhapa's Praise of Dependent Origination
courses.description: Recordings of a summer retreat in which he works through his own commentary on Tsongkhapa's short poem praising the Buddha for teaching emptiness and dependent arising. Streamed in sessions through Jewel Heart's on-demand library.

courses.title: Introduction to Buddhism - Demo Rinpoche
courses.description: A three-session beginners' course on who the Buddha was, what his teaching offers and how its many methods can be brought into a busy modern life. Available as recordings in the on-demand library.

courses.title: Chekawa's 7 Point Mind Training
courses.description: Six recorded sessions from a holiday-weekend teaching on the classic Tibetan lojong text, which trains the mind to turn from self-concern towards cherishing others. Streamed through the on-demand library.

courses.title: The Four Noble Truths - Demo Rinpoche
courses.description: An eight-session course on the Buddha's first teaching: the nature of dissatisfaction, where it comes from, and the path for clearing it away. Recordings stream through the on-demand library.

free_resources.title: Ancient Wisdom. Modern Times. Sunday Talks with Demo Rinpoche
free_resources.description: His weekly hour-long public talk on Sunday mornings, open to newcomers and long-standing students, given in Ann Arbor and on Zoom with an optional group discussion afterwards. Close to three hundred past talks are listed on the page.

free_resources.title: Jataka Tales: Stories from Buddha's Previous Lives
free_resources.description: A free series in which he retells and comments on the Jataka stories of the Buddha's former lives as animals and people, each drawing out a quality such as generosity or patience. The talks can be streamed from the page.

flags: Jewel Heart is not a Spiritpedia listing, so teaches_at is empty; all items come from Jewel Heart's site and YouTube channel (an organisation channel that also carries Gelek Rimpoche and guest teachers).
No email is published; the contact form is Jewel Heart's general support form.
His next retreat (Winter Retreat 2027, 15 to 21 March) is announced only as 'save the dates' with no page of its own, so it is not listed.

The four offerings are recordings inside Jewel Heart's Digital Dharma on-demand library ($10 a month or $120 a year); the subscription page itself mostly describes Gelek Rimpoche's archive, so a human may want to confirm these sessions are included rather than sold separately.
Tier could be argued up on editorial stature (a recognised reincarnate lama and spiritual director of an international organisation with chapters in nine cities); not applied.
Possible duplicate check: Gelek Rimpoche (Jewel Heart's founder, d. 2017) is a different person.
